title: Garmin Instinct 2 Solar Smart Watch in Graphite $338.98 (RRP $679) Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: Garmin Instinct 2 Solar Smart Watch in Graphite $338.98 (RRP $679) Delivered @ Amazon AU

[RSmith] Needs strong sun to charge it. I have one and it struggles to charge in the Melbourne winter sun.
[ihbh] I last charged on July 24 and down to 5 days left in Sydney winter with rain, so haven't been out that much and usually with long sleeve which covers watch up. Just 3 weeks between charges without using GPS.
[RSmith] I don't use GPS either. But Melbourne has been gloomy :(
[EyyBanane] Not much different in Sydney too mate. Mine hasn’t charged significantly with Solar in 20 days, had to plug and charge twice.
[DaveD] @EyyBanane: We are very lucky in Melbourne…we have bright moon evey"day" from last few weeks….and sometimes its shiniest in night…☹️
[eddyah] @EyyBanane: What? It rained on Sunday and was windy today but the last 2 weeks have been sunny as hell you liar.
[heysi] $15 less at WW Marketplace with GET15: https://www.woolworths.com.au/shop/productdetails/1112823125/garmin-instinct-2-solar-gps-watch-graphite
[andyando] Had mine for a few years and looking to replace as the screen is so dim even with the light on and basic clock face
[Magpye] Has the screen got dimmer, or has it always been that way ?
[andyando] It was never amazing but I recall it being brighter when I bought it. I have max brightness which makes it ok when you press light button, but very very hard to read otherwise even with the black on white face.
[x d] Have you changed the clock face to black on white? Much easier to see.
[RandomDealHunter] My Fenix 6 pro did that until I realised it had further backlight brightness settings. If you haven’t toggled these, here is the link from Garmin website: https://www8.garmin.com/manuals-apac/webhelp/instinct2series…
[x d] Also available at jb hifi for$339.00. Ordered online last night and picked up this morning. Paid $325.44 by getting jb hifi gift card from Macquarie for 4% off. Mostly wanting a daily watch without recharging and as a golf GPS 1 to 2 times a week. Pretty good so far.
[colin5000] I have one, it’s not pretty but it does everything you could possibly need. Function over form.
[mrpalazzo26] Bought the 2x solar version approx 2 months ago for a similar price on the Garmin website.
There isn’t much to complain about from my end. I bought the watch the replace my Apple Watch Series 4 and to be a dedicated running/EDC watch.
It can be a bit laggy in some situations, and the interface can be a bit clunky, but overall for the price I paid I am super happy with it. Can honestly say that is has enlightened me a fair bit in terms of my lifestyle and lack of lifestyle choices.
[BargainHunterMYz] Have instinct 2 for 2 years now. Does everything I expect from it, plus now I get so much insights about my training status with help of copilot. No reason to upgrade to other watches except for gps and pacing guidance for extra 5% improvement.
[pongwaters] Had one about 6 months. Looks a bit like a watch you'd pickup from Kmart for $20. Reliable, solid, lots of buttons. Retro. You don't buy it for it's good looks but I reckon it will last a long time.
Doesn't support a lot of the apps on the Garmin store, presumably due to simple/small screen.
[McMaferMur] Get the 2x model, only 2x has torch and nfc payment.
